doc:
Claimant HAS the other driver's details: the agent asks to see them on camera (and the app gets a camera_request),
    never defers them to 'the app' or 'later'.
agent_turns: Hello Jordan, I'm here to help with your auto claim. Are you and everyone else in a safe place?
I'm noting those details about the accident on Coleman Avenue. Would you be able to turn on your camera and show me the damage to your vehicle?
I understand. Do you have a police report or an incident exchange form from the other driver?
That's perfect. Could you please turn on your camera and show me the insurance card and the license plate?
